name: Adductor Muscle Strain
definition: Acute musculotendinous injury of the hip adductor group, common in cutting, kicking and change-of-direction sports.

investigations.principle: Usually clinical; MRI is used for high-grade injury or unclear diagnosis.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Recurrent groin pain should be reclassified rather than repeatedly treated as an acute strain.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vankshana/Mamsa-Snayu injury phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Acute musculotendinous injury of the hip adductor group, common in cutting, kicking and change-of-direction sports.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
